title: Transfer actual component loads before releasing the passive cap
statement: A seven-branch common comb independently takes retention loads before a captured cap lifts1.30mm, translates8.80mm through open-ended slots and parks. Proposed minimum cap forces.13N(two-terminal)/.325N(amplifier) are not supplied by total comb force. A target is positively held by toes/roof before its branch withdraws. Full swept gripper/neighbor solids and force sensing are still unqualified; a suction or total-force command does not establish ownership.
